_notice: Twenty-eight estimates labelled against the engine frozen at commit cc2a5a5, before the runner that reads them was written. Formats, regions and phrasings that the three regression corpora do not contain: estimate-software tables, an insurance adjuster's estimate, scanned and handwritten tickets, pounds sterling, Canadian and Australian terminology, Spanish, prose, options and add-ons, credits and tax lines, wrapped descriptions. Labels are what a person reading the document would say each priced line proposes, as taxonomy ids; `outside` names work the taxonomy has no id for; `tolerated` are ids a reader would accept on the line without calling them wrong. No name, licence number or claim number refers to a real company or person.

documents.title: An email: prose scope, one price, no line items
documents.text:
Subject: Re: roof leak over the back bedroom

Hi Dana,

Thanks for having us out this morning. As discussed, the leak is coming from the
step flashing where the roof meets the second-storey wall; the shingles there are
brittle and the felt under them has gone. We would strip that section back about
6 feet, put down new ice and water membrane, install new step and kick-out flashing,
and reshingle to match as close as we can with the existing color. We'd also reseal
the two pipe boots while we're up there.

All in, including disposal and a 5 year leak-free warranty, it's $1,875. We can be
there Thursday if that works. Half up front and the rest when we're done is fine.

Best,
Marcus
Ridgeline Roof Repair

documents.title: A text message: two prices, one proposed, no document at all
documents.text: hey its Dave from D&L heating. so the heat exchanger is cracked, i showed you the scope pics. can't legally run it. new 80% furnace installed with new t-stat, permit, haul the old one, $4,200 even. or the 96% high efficiency is $5,600 but needs pvc venting out the side. need half to order. lmk
